Package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.device

Record Class DeviceAuthorization

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.device.DeviceAuthorization
Record Components:
deviceCode - the code the CLI presents when polling; a secret, never printed.
userCode - the code the user types (or confirms) on the verification page.
verificationUri - the page where the user approves the request.
verificationUriComplete - the same page with the user code included; may be null (optional in the RFC).
expiresIn - seconds the device code lives; the default when the server sends none or sends null.
interval - minimum seconds between two polls; the default when the server sends none or sends null (Spring Authorization Server does not send one).
public record DeviceAuthorization(String deviceCode, String userCode, String verificationUri, String verificationUriComplete, long expiresIn, long interval) extends Record
Response of the device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628 section 3.2).

      Validates the mandatory members and applies the defaults of the optional ones.

      deviceCode - the device code.
